title: ’Manala’s red occasion dress
summary: For ’Manala, a vivid red palette brings together a structured, patterned bodice and a flowing skirt. The asymmetric strap adds a distinctive line, balancing the detail above with the softer movement below.
imageAlt: ’Manala’s Jane.M appreciation card showing the red dress design, sketches and a personal note
story: The appreciation card brings the design sketches and garment details together, tracing the look from its drawn silhouette to the finished piece shown in the video. A personal note from Jane.M completes the delivery: a small keepsake to accompany a dress made for her.
